description: Judge whether one dependency is maintained, from caller-supplied factual signals only: archival, days since last release and last commit, recent commit activity, and maintainer count. Returns a verdict, a score, the signal bands, and the reasons.

archived.description: Whether the dependency's repository is archived

last_commit_days.description: Days since the last commit (optional; omit if unknown)

last_release_days.description: Days since the last release (optional; omit if none)

open_issues.description: Open issue count (optional; reported, never scored)

name: check_dep_maintenance
